text:
tara_singh: Heads-up: postmortem for 03/20 throttling/latency incident posted. Short summary: sudden throughput drop on dedicated pools caused queueing which magnified p95 from 180ms -> 420ms for ~18m. Error budget impact: ~9% in one window. Postmortem: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4588

matt_zhou: Observed same cluster-level autoscale lag we've seen before. Pattern: scale-up delay when burst traffic hits mixed model variants. Noticed spike of long sequences from a canary rollout.

ana_kovacs: I'll take ownership of the action tracking board for this incident. We need separate remediation lanes: autoscale config, model rollout gating, and observability.

kevin_wu: I'll do the autoscale review. Fix plan: - reduce scale step cooldown from 90s -> 45s in the controller - add a temporary headroom of +15% capacity for dedicated pools during canary windows - add histogram of request seq_len per-route so policy can be seq-aware. ETA: Tue EOD.

matt_zhou: For model side: revert canary that increased max_seq to 4096 for the small test group. We'll implement rollout guard that requires seq_len heatmap < 1% above baseline before enabling. Owner: @matt_zhou, ETA: Mon noon.

ana_kovacs: Observability tasks: - add per-shard queued_requests panel - add rolling 1h and 24h error_budget_burn panels - add alert: `when increase(error_budget_spent[30m]) > 5% AND p95 > 300ms` - surface seq_len percentile in request logs. I opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/558

sre_oncall_bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-4588-FU and subtask INC-4588-FU-1 (autoscale), INC-4588-FU-2 (model rollout), INC-4588-FU-3 (dashboards). Label: recurring-pattern.

tara_singh: Decision on SLOs: keep customer-facing SLA unchanged. Internally we will create a temporary ops SLO for canary windows: p95 < 300ms over 1h for canary traffic. If breached for >2 consecutive windows, auto-rollback policy will kick. Product/legal loop only if public SLA needs editing.

kevin_wu: Can we also add synthetic warmup traffic for low-warmup routes? Proposal: run 2 qps synthetic traffic for 10m after deploy for routes with < 5rps baseline. This reduces cold-cache/queue storms. I can add to deploy pipeline.

ana_kovacs: Added tasks to the tracker with owners & due dates: - Kevin: autoscale cooldown + headroom (owner:@kevin_wu, due: 2026-03-24) - Matt: revert canary + rollout guard (owner:@matt_zhou, due: 2026-03-23) - Ana: dashboard + alert PR review (owner:@ana_kovacs, due: 2026-03-22) - Ops: synthetic warmup traffic in CI (owner: oncall, due: 2026-03-26)

matt_zhou: I ran a quick sim with the lower cooldown and saw scale latency down by ~40% in the harness. Will push a canary and report results.

sre_oncall_bot: Reminder: please add one-line progress update to INC-4588-FU by EOD tomorrow.

tara_singh: Follow-up sync scheduled Wed 11:00 UTC to review mitigations, bump SLO burn projections, and decide if longer-term infra changes needed. Please update tracker before the meeting. Thanks! :calendar:
